messages:
sasha: Quick follow-up on policy provenance + cost propagation. Spotted a case where fallback routing drops the original policy id and we lose why a route was chosen. This breaks billing attribution and makes postmortems hard.

jordan: ugh yeah ran into that in canary yesterday. we saw traffic routed to cheaper-region fallback but logs just showed the final route, not the deciding policy. difficult to reconcile with cost dashboards.

anjali: high-level ask: can we include a tiny provenance blob in the decision envelope that survives fallbacks and forks? e.g. origin_policy, decision_chain, and an optional cost_delta field.

mike: agreed. lightweight and opt-in per-tenant. thought: keep it to 3 fields to avoid payload bloat: `policy_id`, `decision_path` (short list), `budget_impact_estimate`.

rahul: +1. also need to think about PII: policy names can leak tenant hints. maybe policy_id should be opaque (uuid) and mapping stored in control plane.

anjali: yes opaque id in runtime, full mapping in control plane logs behind RBAC. runtime only emits id and small numeric cost_delta.

jordan: re: cost_delta — should that be an estimate at eval time or the actual incremental cost after execution? estimating is cheaper but can diverge.

mike: propose estimate during eval, and then enrich offline with actuals in the cost pipeline. For real-time routing heuristics we only need the estimate.

policy-bot: NOTE: new RFC drafted: "policy-provenance-v1" has schema and opt-in config. Link: https://rfd.redwood/policy-provenance-v1

sasha: nice. a couple integration notes: 1) we must thread provenance through hedged/parallel requests and coalesce decision_path (dedupe entries). 2) TTL for provenance: avoid keeping it forever in caches — 5 minutes default?

rahul: TTL default 5m seems fine. but what about cached route entries that live longer (e.g., 12h)? you'd want cost info to expire earlier than route mapping. maybe separate TTLs: route_ttl vs provenance_ttl.

anjali: yes split TTLs. route_ttl remains as-is. provenance_ttl default 5m and configurable per-tenant. will update RFC.

jordan: edge-case: if a request hits fallback due to region outage, decision_path should include the original preferred region and the outage signal that caused fallback (region_unavailable). otherwise hard to debug cross-region flaps.

mike: include short tokens for signals, e.g. `R:us-east-1`, `S:capacity_low`, `F:policy-penalty-applied`. keep them tiny.

sasha: also want to surface whether cost propagation changed final scoring. small boolean `cost_adjusted` could be helpful for dashboards.

rahul: implementation detail: runtime will attach provenance to routing RPC metadata header `x-rd-provenance` base64(json) when calling downstream adapters. adapters should pass it back untouched. avoid expanding it into logs unless adapter explicitly configured.

anjali: +1. runtime will also emit an evaluation event to telemetry with `{policy_id, decision_path, estimated_cost_delta, cost_adjusted, provenance_ttl}` so analytics can attach to traces.

jordan: sequence diagram idea: request -> policy-eval -> decision (emit provenance) -> route-selector -> adapter (preserve provenance) -> serve. If adapter triggers fallback, it appends its signal and returns new route plus provenance. keep everything idempotent.

mike: quick config sketch:
```
policy_provenance:
  enabled: true
  route_ttl: 12h
  provenance_ttl: 5m
  max_path_len: 8
  opaque_ids: true
```

sasha: perf note: we need benchmarks for header size impact at QPS for heavy tenants. plan: microbench in runtime with `enabled=false|true` and synthetic traffic. keep default off for small customers.

rahul: security: provenance header must be signed or HMACed for private deployments? otherwise a malicious in-cluster component could tamper with decision_path. For hosted we can rely on internal trust but still HMAC is cheap.

anjali: adding HMAC option: `provenance_hmac_key_id` config. runtime signs, control plane verifies during audit queries. adapters don't need to verify in-path.

jordan: last thing: UX — how do product/finance teams query attribution? need a view that maps `policy_id` -> readable name + cost buckets. control plane should export daily rollups.

mike: yes build a rollup job that joins decision events with actual cost logs and policy metadata. that'll power alerts and regression detection.

sasha: ok actionable items: 1) @anjali update RFC with schema + TTL split + HMAC option. 2) @mike add provenance header encode/decode + microbench in runtime. 3) @rahul wire opaque id mapping in control plane and RBAC for mapping queries. 4) @jordan add telemetry event shape and join job spec.

anjali: working on RFC update now. will ping when ready for review.

mike: I'll start a perf branch and post preliminary numbers next week.

rahul: I'll prototype control-plane mapping endpoints and lock down access.

jordan: will draft the rollup job spec and an example dashboard.

sasha: thanks team. low-lift but high-impact for observability and billing. :thumbsup:

policy-bot: RFC update tracked: policy-provenance-v1 -> in-progress. reviewers requested: @anjali @sasha @rahul.
